Now integrating the policy execution adapter with the server, ensuring workspace management and...
  All Gate 2 review blockers have been remediated, verified, and committed on feat/ac-005-worker-
  isolation.
  ──────
  ### Remediation Summary

  #### 1. Wired Production Modules and Unbypassable Seam (Commit agent-council)

  • Production Run Creation & Storage:
      • Implemented session_store.go and session_store.go: computes canonical digests (cbrief-v1,
      csource-v1, cprof-v1), writes briefs to CAS blob storage, and atomically writes to runs,
      run_profiles, controller_leases, and journal_entries.
      • Added ErrRunNotFound and session_store.go.
  • HTTP Run Endpoints:
      • Added POST /v1/runs and GET /v1/runs/{run_id} in runs.go, secured by operator bearer token
      and idempotent via op_id.
  • Managed Worker Adapter:
      • Created adapter.go implementing adapter.Adapter. It fetches the frozen canonical run
      profile from storage, allocates a session workspace via workspace.go, and executes worker
      turns strictly via executor.go.
      • Wired as default adapter in server.go when adp == nil. Added --workspace-base-dir flag in
      service.go.
  • End-to-End Daemon Seam Test:
      • Added worker_seam_test.go (TestServer_ProductionRunCreationAndWorkerSeam) testing run
      creation via POST /v1/runs, controller adoption and connect, turn queuing/releasing, and
      production execution through PolicyExecutor.


  #### 2. Strict OS Isolation Enforcement (Commit agent-council)

  • Linux Network Namespaces:
      • Implemented executor_linux.go and executor_other.go.
      • On Linux under strict + none, child processes launch with CLONE_NEWUSER | CLONE_NEWNET and
      single UID/GID mapping, forcing socket operations to fail immediately with ENETUNREACH.
      • Verified with real subprocess socket execution in executor_linux_test.go.
  • Fail-Closed Semantics:
      • Non-Linux platforms or Linux with allowlist/readonly under strict mode immediately fail
      closed with ErrUnsupportedIsolationCapability.


  #### 3. Single Proposal Member per Contributing Session/Contributor (Commit agent-council)

  • In proposal_sets.go, ReleaseArtifacts validates that every proposal member belongs to a unique
  session_id and unique author_contributor, rejecting duplicate attempts with
  ErrDuplicateProposalMember.
  ──────
  ### Verification Evidence

  1. Unit and Package Tests:
    CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./... -count=1
  Result: ok across all packages (cmd/council, internal/adapter, internal/adapter/execpolicy,
  internal/adapter/workspace, internal/client, internal/council, internal/service,
  internal/storage).
  2. Race Detector:
    go test -race ./... -count=1
  Result: ok across all packages with zero data races.
  3. Formatting and Linting:
    gofmt -l cmd internal
    go vet ./...
  Result: Clean (zero output).
  4. Cross-Platform Compilation:
    GOOS=windows CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./... && GOOS=windows CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -c -o /dev/null .
  /internal/service/ ./cmd/council/ ./internal/adapter/execpolicy/
    GOOS=darwin CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./... && GOOS=darwin CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -c -o /dev/null .
  /internal/service/ ./internal/adapter/execpolicy/
  Result: Clean compilation on both Windows and Darwin.
  5. Whitespace Diff Integrity:
    git diff --check 36c3dcc..HEAD
  Result: Clean.
  ──────
  The branch feat/ac-005-worker-isolation is ready for Gate 2 approval.
